description:
FILED s411 (Fable) from docs/plan-one-compiler-s411.md Phase B (E5.1 as a FUNCTION, not an object).  1 session, IDENTICAL (refactor; corpus-diff proves it).

MEASURED s411: three copies of the bucket dance (_lower_expr 8717-8754, _fallback_stmt_capture 9527-9608, VarAnnotator::_tw_expr_parse 689-728 with no drain); ~1 500 embedded blocks per corpus are compiled by v1's TEXT route and DISCARDED (924 in the native attempt — gone with #384; 882 in the file-level analysis parse, 27 in _expr_scalar_rooted, 85 in _lower_sub_inner's per-sub analysis) — every embedded block is compiled ~2.4x; v1 _process_element is 11.2 s of a 50 s 12-file sample.  VarAnnotator walks blocks through PPI (_tw_top_blocks), never through the compiled body — verified by grep (no body_form/body_cl/raw_lambda/lambda_form reads in VarAnnotator.pm).

STEPS: B1 PExpr attribute analysis_only => 1: the three block sites (PExpr.pm ~3248 map/grep/sort, ~3401 eval/do/&-proto, ~3537 anon sub) leave the body uncompiled (no _v2_embedded_body, no parse_block_*); used by VarAnnotator::_tw_expr_parse and Parser2::_expr_scalar_rooted (+ any other analysis parse found by grep of Pl::PExpr->new); their save/redirect/restore blocks deleted (nothing can emit).  B2 Pl::Parser::capture_v1(sub {...}) in Parser.pm (where the sections live): saves _sections/_cur_bucket/indent_level/_local_let_depth/_block_depth, installs the scratch section and the _v2_embed hook, runs, drains ALL buckets by name, restores, returns { runtime, decls, defs, opens }; _lower_expr and _fallback_stmt_capture become callers; Parser2 stops reading those five fields (grep count -> 0).  B3 lower_embedded_block handles its own decline: the hook ALWAYS answers — on a decline shape it calls v1's block compiler through capture_v1 and returns the text as a raw form; PExpr's two-route logic collapses to "ask the hook"; then _lower_expr's own drain is deletable.

BAR: corpus-diff IDENTICAL after each of B1/B2/B3; tools/prove-core; tools/sub-call-census.pl before/after — _process_element incl. time must FALL (B1) and whole-corpus transpile time must not rise; PCL_E2_RAW_CENSUS decl:no-hook count -> 0 in lowering parses after B3.

ORDER: after #384 (Phase A) — B2's callers are the post-A shapes.

DONE s412 (Fable): B1 = 719ef4c, B2+B3 = 97cc944.  See docs/session-log.md s412 and docs/DECIDED.md s412.  Measured: B1 cut about 1 % of compile time (the discarded block compiles were small); the plan's _process_element 11.2 s is the module prototype pre-scan -> task #391.
subject: Phase B (plan-one-compiler-s411 §2): ONE seam function — PExpr analysis_only (no block compiles in analysis parses), Pl::Parser::capture_v1 owning the bucket dance, hook-only embedded blocks (lower_embedded_block handles its own decline)
